svg.text: four triggers, traced through the code. orange = where it starts. paths are real files under server/src and client/src.
they open it (or click a link) — no model anywhere on this path
the inbox sync ticks — sorted cheap first, read only with permission
MongoDB :27018 — Email · Contact · Signal · Memory · Proposal · Label · AgentRun · InboundMessage · Category · Webhook · AiSettings(keys encrypted)
Redis :6380 — emailQueue + aiQueue (BullMQ) · both containers via docker compose
rule of the house — a model call only ever exits through a Proposal; a person (or trust earned from their Labels) makes it real
